calls.title: Dani Olean and Ashley Stirrup + Christian Liebenow
calls.summary: Logan (Box) discussed evaluating GrowthBook as an AB testing platform, focusing on its agentic workflows, feature flagging, and warehouse-native data integration to consolidate their current stack (Adobe, Split, Chameleon). Key pain points included the need for end-to-end testing across marketing and product, data linking between visitor and account IDs, and governance features. Christian Liebenow and Ashley Stirrup (GrowthBook) demonstrated the platform. Next steps: Christian will send competitive analysis notes and share availability for a follow-up call with Logan’s marketing counterpart and engineers.

calls.title: Dani Olean and Ashley Stirrup + Christian Liebenow
calls.summary: The meeting highlighted the need for tech stack consolidation to address challenges in manually stitching data from various sources like Adobe Target and revenue tools into Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The proposed solution involves a warehouse-native platform that integrates directly with GCP to unify data sources, supporting seamless analysis. Advantages include cross-platform experimentation capabilities, streamlined experiment setup with roles for governance, and advanced analytics features for ongoing measurement of cohort performance. The conversation also emphasized the platform's competitive edge over tools like Adobe and Optimizely, and next steps involve preparing for follow-up demos and further evaluations.
calls.keywords: AB testing, data stitching, experimentation platform, feature flags, agentic workflows, data warehouse native
